title: Te Ingoa i Tukuna i mua i te Whānautanga
intro: Whakaarohia he wāhi tapu marino e kī ana i te inoi nui i muri i ngā tau roa o te tatari. Mai i te mea kāore e kitea ka puta mai he whakautu e mau ana i tētahi ingoa kāore anō kia hoatu i mua, e whakaari ana i te whakaaro nui mai i ngā tau tōmua me te oranga e tohuhia ana e te aroha, te ngākau pono, me te parakore.
clues: I tapaina ahau e Allah tonu i mua i tōku whānautanga, he ingoa kāore anō kia hoatu ki tētahi i mua i ahau.
I whakaaetia ahau hei whakautu ki te inoi nui a ngā mātua kaumātua i whakaaro rā kāore e taea te whānau he uri.
I homai ki ahau te whakaaro nui, te whakaaro nui, me te Karaipiture i ahau e tamariki ana.
He tangata atawhai ahau ki ōku mātua, he tangata aroha ki ētahi atu; kāore hoki ahau i te whakapehapeha, i te tutu rānei.
I whakaritea e Allah te rangimārie ki runga i ahau i te rā i whānau ai ahau, i te rā e mate ai ahau, ā, i te rā e whakaarahia ora ai ahau.
I whiwhi tōku matua a Zakariyya i ngā rongopai mōku mai i ngā anahera i a ia e tū ana i roto i te mihrab e inoi ana.

identity.label: Ko wai ahau?
options: Poropiti Shu'ayb (Ietoro)
Poropiti a Idris (Enoka)
Poropiti a Ihaka (Ihaka)
Poropiti a Hohepa (Yusup)
Poropiti a Yahya (Hoani)

trial.label: Te Manaakitanga me te Whakamātautau
options: I horomia e te ika nui mō te wehenga atu i te riri
Ka maka ki roto i te ahi mura hei wahi i ngā whakapakoko
I whakakahoretia he wāhi noho, ā, i waiho kia whāngaihia e te wuruhi wahine
I tukuna ki ngā mātua kaumātua i muri i te inoi nui
I tū atu ki a Parao, ā, i ārahi i te haerenga ki tērā taha o te moana
trial.answer: I tukuna ki ngā mātua kaumātua i muri i te inoi nui

location.label: Te Wāhi Matua
options: Te wāhi tapu (mihrab) i kauwhautia ai ngā rongopai
Te ahi mura i whakaritea e ngā kaikarakia whakapakoko
Te puku o te ika nui i te moana hohonu
Te ana i okioki ai ngā moe mō ngā rautau
Te raorao o ngā pōpokorua i runga i te hīkoi kingi
location.answer: Te wāhi tapu (mihrab) i kauwhautia ai ngā rongopai

outcome.label: Te Whakahonoretanga Atua
options: I whiua mai i te rangi e ngā kōhatu paru tunua
I horomia oratia e te whenua mō te whakapehapeha mō te taonga
I whakangaromia e te whatitiri nui mō te whakangote i te kamera uha
I toremi tahi me te ope whakakake i te moana wehe
Kia tau te rangimārie ki ahau i te rā i whānau ai ahau, i te rā e mate ai ahau, i te rā hoki e whakaarahia ora ai ahau
outcome.answer: Kia tau te rangimārie ki ahau i te rā i whānau ai ahau, i te rā e mate ai ahau, i te rā hoki e whakaarahia ora ai ahau

arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌۭ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌۭ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verse: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when I have reached old age and my wife is barren?" He [the angel] said, "Such is Allāh; He does what He wills." (3:40)
